name: gitring
description: gitring lets many coding agents change one repository at the same time. Agents send a plan. gitring compares it with the 20 nearest plans, sends change requests instead of rejections, and merges work only when the tests pass. It runs on Cloudflare Workers and Artifacts.

GITRING_SECRET.description: Seals the sign-in credentials. Make a value with `openssl rand -base64 32`.

GITRING_SETUP_TOKEN.description: Opens the `/setup` page before an owner signs in. Make a value with `openssl rand -hex 16`.

GITRING_OWNERS.description: The owners of this deployment, separated by commas. Use `github:your-login` or `google:you@example.com`.

GITRING_KEY.description: Optional key for scripts. It acts as an owner on every project. Make a value with `openssl rand -hex 24`.

AI.description: Workers AI. It runs the conflict-check model, the built-in agents and the guess of the test command.

ARTIFACTS.description: Cloudflare Artifacts. It stores the git repositories of all projects. It needs the Workers Paid plan.

LOADER.description: Worker Loader (Dynamic Workers). It runs the tests of the worker runner and the live previews.

DRYDOCK.description: A Durable Object that starts one Cloudflare container for each work copy. The container runs the tests.
